description: Update a discount (partial): only the fields provided change, and at least one is required. code, type and currency are frozen once the discount has been used - changing one is refused, while resending the stored value is accepted. Orders already placed keep the discount they were priced with. A code with any minimum (minSubtotal for the default currency, minSubtotalByCurrency for additional currencies) applies only in the currencies those minimums name. Refused when no discount matches idOrSlug. To only switch it on or off, set_discount_enabled; to add a code, create_discount. Returns the discount's id, code and enabled.

code.description: New code; stored upper-case. Frozen once the code was used

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of a 'fixed' discount. Frozen once the code was used

enabled.description: Switch the code on or off; set_discount_enabled does only this

endsAt.description: ISO date-time the code expires; must be after startsAt

idOrSlug.description: The discount's id or code to update (list_discounts)

minSubtotal.description: Minimum subtotal in minor units: the code's own currency for 'fixed', the default currency otherwise. null clears it - with minSubtotalByCurrency set, the code then no longer applies to default-currency carts

minSubtotalByCurrency.description: 'percentage' and 'free_shipping' only: replaces the per-currency minimums for carts in additional currencies; [] clears them. Omit to keep them. Changing such a code to 'fixed' needs [] here

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies)

startsAt.description: ISO date-time the code becomes valid

type.description: New type. Frozen once the code was used

value.description: Percent for 'percentage', minor units for 'fixed', 0 for 'free_shipping'

name: update_discount
title: Update discount
